serializedLocalizedConversation.mainText:
You: Are you serious? We are strangers! How can you give away something so expensive for free?!
Mrs. Fisher: Let’s consider it as an investment in the younger generation.
You: Big thanks Mrs. I will try to catch something with it later.
Mrs. Fisher: That won’t do, kid. You WILL catch something with it, capisce? 
You: Yes. I will catch something, for sure.
Mrs. Fisher: Here is some bait too. You won’t catch anything without it.
You: What if I run out of bait before I catch a fish?
Mrs. Fisher: There’s that website called real men fishing dot ic. They have by far the best prices and free shipping. Something incredible in this economy.
You: Really? Real men fishing?
Mrs. Fisher: What about it?
You: It’s just that, you are a woman…{{wi}} and…{{wi}} nevermind…
You: I will be going now, thanks for everything!
Mrs. Fisher: No problem kid.
